fullPassage: Dolphins' brains have evolved specialized areas dedicated to echolocation, allowing them to process acoustic information more quickly and with less energy. One key adaptation is the structure of the dolphin's auditory pathway. The signals from the ears are rapidly transmitted to the auditory cortex, the brain region responsible for processing sound. However, unlike many other mammals, dolphins have a highly specialized auditory cortex with distinct areas dedicated to processing different aspects of echolocation signals. Some areas may be responsible for analyzing the timing of echoes, while others focus on the frequency content or the intensity of the sound. This specialization allows the dolphin's brain to process echo information in parallel, rather than sequentially. Imagine a factory assembly line, where different workers are responsible for different tasks. By dividing the work among specialized areas, the brain can process information much faster and more efficiently. This parallel processing reduces the cognitive load associated with echolocation, allowing dolphins to react quickly to changes in their environment.

❌ ② rapidly: 빠르게. 속도의 축이라 효율성의 반대가 아님
❌ ③ neatly: 깔끔하게. 효율과 겹치는 긍정 어감이라 반의어 아님
✅ ④ wastefully: 낭비하여. 자원을 낭비한다는 뜻으로 efficiently의 반의어 ←정답

questions.passage:
(A) The dolphin's brain can <u>process</u> sound signals very quickly and accurately.
(B) Learning a new language is a slow <u>process</u> that takes many years of effort.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)의 밑줄 친 process의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A): 처리하다(뇌가 신호를 처리하다) - (B): 과정(언어 학습의 과정)
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A): 과정 - (B): 처리하다: 두 의미가 반대로 배치됨
✅ ② (A): 처리하다 - (B): 과정: (A)는 동사 '처리하다', (B)는 명사 '과정'으로 정확 ←정답
❌ ③ (A): 처리하다 - (B): 처리하다: (B)는 'a slow process(느린 과정)'로 명사 '과정'
❌ ④ (A): 과정 - (B): 과정: (A)는 'can process(처리할 수 있다)'로 동사 '처리하다'
det.tip: process signals = (정보를) 처리하다 / a slow process = 과정

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a change in a living thing that makes it better suited to survive in its environment"

det.korean: 적응(adaptation): 생물이 환경에서 더 잘 살아남도록 돕는 변화
det.analysis:
✅ ① adaptation: 적응. 환경에 더 잘 맞게 하는 생물의 변화라는 정의에 정확히 부합 ←정답
❌ ② reaction: 반응. 일시적 반응이지 생존을 위한 변화가 아님
❌ ③ invention: 발명. 생물의 변화가 아니라 인간이 만든 것
❌ ④ tradition: 전통. 생물학적 변화와 무관
det.tip: adaptation = 환경 생존에 유리하도록 생물에게 생기는 변화(적응)

questions.passage: The signals from the ears are rapidly transmitted to the auditory cortex, the brain region responsible for processing sound. However, unlike many other mammals, dolphins have a highly specialized auditory cortex with distinct areas __________ (dedicate) to processing different aspects of echolocation signals.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: 과거분사형. dedicate → dedicated
det.analysis: dedicate(동사: 바치다, 전념하게 하다)를 과거분사 dedicated로 변환. 명사 areas를 뒤에서 수식하는 '~에 전념/할당된'이라는 분사 형태가 필요하다. areas (which are) dedicated to ~ 구조.

questions.passage: Some areas may be responsible for analyzing the timing of echoes, while others focus on the frequency content or the intensity of the sound. This __________ (specialize) allows the dolphin's brain to process echo information in parallel, rather than sequentially.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: 명사형. specialize → specialization
det.analysis: specialize(동사: 전문화하다)를 명사형 specialization(전문화, 분업)으로 변환. 지시어 This 뒤에 주어 역할을 할 명사가 필요하며, 앞 문장에서 설명한 '영역별 분담'을 가리키므로 specialization으로 쓴다.

questions.passage: Dolphins' brains have evolved specialized areas dedicated to echolocation, allowing them to process acoustic information more quickly and with less energy. One key adaptation is the structure of the dolphin's auditory pathway. The signals from the ears are rapidly transmitted to the auditory cortex, the brain region responsible for processing sound. However, unlike many other mammals, dolphins have a highly specialized auditory cortex with distinct areas dedicated to processing different aspects of echolocation signals. Some areas may be responsible for analyzing the timing of echoes, while others focus on the frequency content or the intensity of the sound. This specialization allows the dolphin's brain to process echo information in parallel, rather than sequentially. Imagine a factory assembly line, where different workers are responsible for __________. By dividing the work among specialized areas, the brain can process information much faster and more efficiently. This parallel processing reduces the cognitive load associated with echolocation, allowing dolphins to react quickly to changes in their environment.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 공장 조립 라인에서 서로 다른 작업자가 '서로 다른 일(different tasks)'을 맡는다
det.analysis:
❌ ① a single goal(하나의 목표): 각 작업자가 '서로 다른' 일을 맡는다는 대비 구조와 반대
❌ ② the same job(같은 일): '서로 다른 작업자'가 각자 맡는 것이므로 '같은 일'은 모순
❌ ③ their own rewards(각자의 보상): 보상은 본문에 근거 없음
✅ ④ different tasks: 전문화된 뇌 영역의 비유로, 작업자마다 '서로 다른 일'을 담당한다는 맥락 ←정답
det.tip: different workers are responsible for ______ → different tasks(서로 다른 일)

questions.passage: Dolphins' brains have evolved specialized areas dedicated to echolocation, allowing them to process acoustic information more quickly and with less energy. One key adaptation is the structure of the dolphin's auditory pathway. The signals from the ears are rapidly transmitted to the auditory cortex, the brain region responsible for processing sound. However, unlike many other mammals, dolphins have a highly specialized auditory cortex with distinct areas dedicated to processing different aspects of echolocation signals. Some areas may be responsible for analyzing the timing of echoes, while others focus on the frequency content or the intensity of the sound. This specialization allows the dolphin's brain to process echo information __________, rather than sequentially. Imagine a factory assembly line, where different workers are responsible for different tasks. By dividing the work among specialized areas, the brain can process information much faster and more efficiently. This parallel processing reduces the cognitive load associated with echolocation, allowing dolphins to react quickly to changes in their environment.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 메아리 정보를 순차적이 아니라 '병렬로(in parallel)' 처리한다
det.analysis:
❌ ① step by step(단계적으로): 'rather than sequentially(순차적이 아니라)'와 대비되어야 하는데 step by step은 순차적과 같은 의미라 모순
❌ ② one at a time(한 번에 하나씩): 순차적 처리와 같은 의미라 'rather than sequentially'와 모순
✅ ③ in parallel: 순차적(sequentially)이 아니라 '병렬로' 동시에 처리한다는 맥락 ←정답
❌ ④ in silence(조용히): 처리 방식(병렬/순차)과 무관
det.tip: process ... ______, rather than sequentially → in parallel(병렬로)
